items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: So I went to Smallens already who was conducting the show, and I asked him did he object to having black musicians in the band.

ctx.x: How long were you with it?

Oh, I guess I stayed in there, oh, about six months, because the next year -- see, I stayed in there, say, from about April. Maybe a little longer than that. April to -- I think it was around April I went in there. From April to about January or February, when "Porgy and Bess" was getting ready to open up, because Cab had wrote me a letter when we was in California at the Oasis, asking me. Or another place we played with Earl called -- at Bush and Powell, The Hangover. It was Doc Dougherty's place. We played out…

Milt in mind, and somebody else, you know. But when you got back here, when the show got back -- now we -- I'm still with Earl while this is going on, and what Earl is doing, he starts me out at a salary -- he started me out at 250.00. Well, I was happy because I liked to play with Earl and I liked his piano and everything, and I can make both ends meet then, you know. So now he comes up and he says, "Well, I'm going to have to cut you 25.00." So I said okay. I said it was kind of rough on me, and so and so, but…
